custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Have a tracked part, part A, with 1 on hand, Min 5 and Max 10, so it is under-supplied.
  • Have a tracked part, part C, with 7 on hand, Min 5 and Max 10, so it is well-supplied.
  • Have a tracked part, part D, with 12 on hand, Min 5 and Max 10, so it is over-supplied.
  • Have an untracked part, part B, with 1 on its shelf and a Min 5 and Max 10 saved while it was tracked.
  • Give parts A, B, C and D part numbers that start with the same text, so one search lists all four.
  • Start on the Inventory page (Parts in the top bar, then Inventory in the left menu), on the Active tab.

How to set this up on the QA site (https://sv10647.qa.shopview.com):

  • Admin at the test location: on the QA site's sign-in screen choose Admin. The test location is Staging Heavy Duty - 9919; its name shows in the box at the top right. If another name shows, click that box, click the name beside Change Location: and pick Staging Heavy Duty - 9919.
  • To create a part: click Parts in the top bar, Inventory in the left menu, then New Inventory Part. Fill Description and Part Number (for example ZZAUTOTEST-PL-C425645-A for part A, -B for part B), pick a Category, type a Cost and a Sell Price, type the Quantity in the bin row (the location's bin, for example General Storage, is offered), then click Save. Leave Track quantities and cost of goods on for a tracked part; click it off for an untracked part. Add Bin Location adds a second bin; Vendor, Manufacturer, Core Charge, Min, Max and Tags are in the same window. Parts that must start with the same text all start ZZAUTOTEST-PL-C425645-, so searching for that finds them all.
  • The Search box above the Inventory list opens when you click Search (the magnifier).
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Parts A, B, C and D are listed.

Step 2:

  • Part A is listed (1 is below its Min of 5).
  • Part B is not listed, although it also holds 1 against a Min of 5.

Step 3:

  • Part C is listed.
  • Part B is not listed.

Step 4:

  • Part D is listed.
  • Part B is not listed.

Step 5:

  • Parts A, B, C and D are all listed, part B among them.
